correctness.rationale: Read entire RESULT.md and source verification descriptions; analyzed stationary renewal perpetuity U=Σ_{j≥0}a^j L_j with unit symmetric Laplace increments. Independence yields exact product mgf M_epsilon(theta)=∏(1-theta² exp(-epsilon j))^-1 for |theta|<1 and divergence at |theta|≥1. Riemann sum of minus log terms gives epsilon log M→Li2(theta²), with locally uniform first two derivatives. Strictly positive second derivative and derivative blow-up at theta=±1 give unique tilt theta_y and good even strictly convex rate I(y)=sup_{|theta|<1}(theta y-Li2(theta²)). Chernoff exponential tightness plus compact covers gives closed upper LDP; exponential tilting has EY→y and VarY=O(epsilon), yielding open lower LDP without invalid boundary differentiability. Legendre series gives y²/4−y⁴/64+O(y^6); Li2 endpoint expansion gives |y|−pi²/6+O(exp(-|y|/2)). A separate characteristic-function limit yields sqrt(epsilon)U⇒N(0,2). Independent high-precision product/Legendre checks at four tilt and displacement samples are consistency only, not the infinite LDP proof.
